intro:
Mexico City is the command centre of the nearshoring boom: corporates in Polanco and Santa Fe coordinate the factory build-outs happening across the Bajío, US firms expand their Mexican delivery and shared-services centres, and the banks fund it all through their own digital transformations. Project managers with international certification and cross-border fluency are the profile in shortest supply. Live online training runs continuously through the year for Mexico City, with weekend Saturday–Sunday and weekday Wednesday–Thursday cohorts timed to sensible local hours; the schedule below shows the exact Mexico City start and finish for each upcoming batch. Throughout: live weekend instruction in English, exam application guidance, full-length mock exams, and trainer access until you pass. Cohorts frequently include Mexican professionals preparing for US-facing delivery roles at nearshored operations.

Mexico City is the nearshoring decade's command center: global manufacturers moving supply chains south run their program offices from the capital, the banks and conglomerates headquartered here fund their own modernization portfolios, and delivery centers serving US clients grow quarter over quarter. Cross-border programs run on internationally recognized credentials — certification here is a passport as much as a differentiator. The course runs live online across two consecutive days shown in Mexico City local time on this page, in English, matching how cross-border programs actually operate. faq.q: What are the class timings in Mexico City?
faq.a: Live classes run 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM CT, which is 08:00 AM – 05:00 PM CST in Mexico City. You can pick a weekend (Sat–Sun) or a weekday (Wed–Thu) cohort; each completes the course over two consecutive days.

faq.q: Is the training online or at a venue in Mexico City?
faq.a: All batches are 100% live online, taught by an instructor over video with interactive exercises — there is no venue to travel to in Mexico City. You need a laptop, a stable connection and a free weekend.

faq.q: Is the certificate different if I attend from Mexico?
faq.a: No. The certification is issued by the same global body regardless of where you attend from, and holds identical recognition with employers in Mexico and internationally.

faq.q: Can my employer in Mexico City sponsor the course?
faq.a: Yes. We issue invoices suitable for corporate sponsorship and reimbursement, and most employers in Mexico accept them under learning and development budgets. Group pricing is available for teams.
